rationale: The schema change requires migrating from string to bytes for `entity_id` in v2. The edits encode/decode UTF-8 strings as specified, preserving the existing behavior for v1 and standalone samples. All candidate lines were affected by the type change: literal-key assignments (lines 15, 21) now require UTF-8 decoding of the byte array to string, and construction (line 39) requires explicit UTF-8 encoding of the string to bytes. The relay logic remains unchanged as it only processes v1 entities.
assumptions: UTF-8 encoding/decoding is safe for all valid identifiers in this context (no mixed-version interop).
The protobuf-generated `EntityId` property in C# returns a `ByteString`, which has a `.ToByteArray()` method.
No other implicit string-to-bytes conversions are needed beyond explicit encoding/decoding.
